attempts.text:
**The window starts in a persistent four-gene spine.** Columns 0 to 3, `dcuR`, `dcuB`, `fumB` and `yjdF`, are carried by 96 to 100% of chromosomes and sit in a region of plasticity in 0 to 0.2% of calls. The model names 98 to 99.8% of them, and no column here hesitates more than 0.11 bits.

**Column 4 is a fork at `melB`**, carried by 66% of chromosomes, with an IS1-like element transposase at 25%. The model names 87% of calls there and hesitates 0.96 bits, the most hesitant column of the window. Then columns 5 to 15, `melA` to `rdcB`, stay persistent at 93 to 97%, named 93 to 98%.

**The phosphonate stretch follows.** Columns 17 to 23, `yjdM` to `phnH`, are persistent at 91 to 97%, named 87 to 96%. Columns 25 to 33, `phnI` to `yjdP`, are persistent at 90 to 95% but reach 74% in a region of plasticity, and naming drops to 58% at `phnK`. Columns 34 to 39 are fork and variable columns, 69 to 77% in a region of plasticity, named 83 to 97%.

**A long persistent run follows**, `yjcS` to `actP`, 90 to 96% carried, named 88 to 98%. The variable columns 58, 63 and 69 to 75 carry `espX5`, `pdeC` and `aphA` to `pspG`. The window ends in fork and variable columns 76 to 79, where a second branch of 4 families, `dgkA` to `ubiC`, is carried by 16 to 25% of chromosomes.

**Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside**, 0.70 against 0.23 bits, and names fewer genes, 79% against 95%. Overall it names 93% of genes at 0.29 bits. The window ends at column 79, `dinF`, in 52% of chromosomes.

label: dcuR
facts:
WINDOW: the dcuR window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor dcuR, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,000 to 4,079 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying dcuR once); 43,039 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.29 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 34,411 calls, named 97%, 0.17 bits; shell 8,285 calls, named 79%, 0.72 bits; cloud 343 calls, named 29%, 2.35 bits. Outside an RGP 37,702 calls, named 95%, 0.23 bits; inside an RGP 5,337 calls, named 79%, 0.70 bits. Columns: 58 spine, 6 fork, 16 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.70 against 0.23 bits) and names fewer genes (79% against 95%); 5,337 of the 43,039 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 4 (melB) 0.96 bits, RGP 0.4%; column 70 (yjbS) 0.72 bits, RGP 5%; column 77 (zur) 0.67 bits, RGP 20%. The 8 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 92%, 0.40 bits on average; the other 72 columns: named 93%, 0.28 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 34-39 (fork and variable columns), RGP 69-77%; the least: columns 0-3 (spine), RGP 0-0.2%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-3 (4 columns) spine: share 96-100%, all P, RGP 0-0.2%. Genes: dcuR, dcuB "anaerobic C4-dicarboxylate transpor…", fumB, yjdF "DUF2238 domain-containing protein". named 98-99.8% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 1 (dcuB), named 98%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.11 bits (column 3 (yjdF)).
2. column 4 fork: RGP 0.4%. named 87%; 0.96 bits.
   4: melB S 66%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 25%
3. columns 5-15 (11 columns) spine: share 93-97%, all P, RGP 1-3%. Genes: melA "alpha-galactosidase", melR, adiA, adiY, adiC "arginine/agmatine antiporter", eptA, basR, pmrB "two-component system sensor histidi…", pmrR, proP, rdcB. named 93-98% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 15 (rdcB), named 93%; most hesitant at column 9 (adiC), 0.26 bits.
4. column 16 variable: RGP 2%. named 90%; 0.49 bits.
   16: crfC P 88%
5. columns 17-23 (7 columns) spine: share 91-97%, 6 P, 1 S, RGP 2-4%. Genes: yjdM "zinc ribbon domain-containing prote…", yjdN "VOC family metalloprotein YjdN", phnC, phnD, phnF, phnG "phosphonate C-P lyase system protei…", phnH. named 87-96% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 21 (phnF), named 87%, 0.47 bits.
6. column 24 variable: RGP 4%. named 93%; 0.17 bits.
   24: ecnA P 2%
7. columns 25-33 (9 columns) spine: share 90-95%, 8 P, 1 S, RGP 4-74%. Genes: phnI, phnJ, phnK "phosphonate C-P lyase system protei…", phnL, phnM, phnN, phnO, phnP, yjdP "DDRRRQL repeat protein YjdP". named 58-97% (mean 86%), fewest named at column 27 (phnK), named 58%; most hesitant at column 33 (yjdP), 0.45 bits.
8. columns 34-39 (6 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 69-77%. named 83-97% (mean 91%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 34, named 83%, 0.62 bits.
   34 fork: alsR S 71%; also "RpiB/LacA/LacB family sugar-phosphate i…" S 16%
   columns 35-39 variable, share 68-70%, all S: alsB "D-allose transporter substrate-bind…" 69%, alsA 68%, alsC 68%, alsE 70%, alsK 69%
9. columns 40-57 (18 columns) spine: share 90-96%, 17 P, 1 S, RGP 2-57%. Genes: yjcS "alkyl sulfatase C-terminal domain-c…", ytcA "YtcA family lipoprotein", mdtN, mdtO "multidrug efflux transporter permea…", mdtP, fdhF, yjcO "Sel1 family TPR-like repeat protein…", gltP, nrfG, nrfF, nrfE, nrfD, nrfC "cytochrome c nitrite reductase Fe-S…", nrfB, nrfA, acs, yjcH "DUF485 domain-containing protein", actP. named 88-98% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 49 (nrfF), named 88%; most hesitant at column 57 (actP), 0.30 bits.
10. column 58 variable: RGP 2%. named 93%; 0.41 bits.
   58: espX5 S 66%
11. columns 59-62 (4 columns) spine: share 96%, all P, RGP 2-4%. Genes: yjcE "Na+/H+ antiporter", ghxP, soxR "redox-sensitive transcriptional act…", soxS. named 89-95% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 59 (yjcE), named 89%, 0.42 bits.
12. column 63 variable: RGP 4%. named 89%; 0.56 bits.
   63: pdeC S 85%
13. columns 64-68 (5 columns) spine: share 94-96%, all P, RGP 4-5%. Genes: yjcB "YjcB family protein", ssb1, uvrA, yjbR "MmcQ/YjbR family DNA-binding protein", yjbQ "secondary thiamine-phosphate syntha…". named 92-95% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 64 (yjcB), named 92%, 0.49 bits.
14. columns 69-79 (11 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 5-21%. named 85-94% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 71, named 85%; most hesitant at column 70, 0.72 bits.
   a second branch of 4 families through columns 76-79, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 16-25%, all P; the branch's families: dgkA, plsB, ubiA, ubiC
   columns 69-75 variable, share 47-88%, 6 P, 1 S: aphA 88%, yjbS 47%, tyrB 85%, alr 83%, dnaB 84%, qorA 83%, pspG 83%
   76 fork: dusA P 82%
   77 fork: zur P 70%
   78 fork: yjbJ P 63% "CsbD family protein"; also yjbM S 25%
   79 fork: dinF P 52%; also lexA P 34%
